onboarding.hint.later.title: Park now, plan later
onboarding.hint.later.body: Capture ideas or park plans until you are ready. Parked items keep their type: week plans go to this week, day plans to today, and long-term goals to a cycle you choose.
onboarding.hint.sessionDuration.title: Durations power the timer
onboarding.hint.sessionDuration.body: A focus block with a set duration counts down to a notification when time is up, and its focus time rolls up into your day, week and month.
onboarding.hint.crossLink.title: Link the levels
onboarding.hint.crossLink.body: Link a weekly item to a long-term goal, or a daily task to a weekly or long-term goal, so every small step visibly serves the bigger plan.
